facts.fact: The Energy Efficiency (Refrigerating Appliances) Regulations 2026, in operation from 1 May 2026, name the Mauritius Standards Bureau as a body established under the Mauritius Standards Bureau Act, which the regulations use to verify appliance compliance with the energy performance standards; the document names no IT or data standard.

systems.owner: Government of Mauritius (statutory body under the Mauritius Standards Bureau Act)
Established under the Mauritius Accreditation Service Act

note: Energy-efficiency product standards and MSB test-report verification are non-IT; the Mauritius Accreditation Service is an accreditation body, class other; no certification against an IT or data standard is stated.
